lens: Information and discoverability — factual comprehension (simulated expertise/user lens)
reason: The public proposition is understandable: student-led consulting, practical recommendations, pro-bono engagements, and membership across majors. Client scope, team size, semester length, confidentiality and next steps are discoverable; student materials and evaluation criteria are explicit. Desktop and mobile captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy and distinct audience actions. I traced Work → engagement FAQ → contact form → confirmation through source and the supplied passing Chromium journey, whose contact response is intercepted. Public metadata, private noindex defaults and request-time project/social-image reads are thoughtfully implemented. The empty approved-project inventory and pending-approval statement avoid invented outcomes. However, recruitment failure is presented as a publication fact, and the supplied local evidence cannot establish world-class task success or hosted release readiness. This is an independent AI source/capture assessment, not human endorsement.

findings.evidence: fetchPublicRecruitment discards the RPC error and returns { cycle: null } when data is absent. Join defaults missing events to [], offers recruitment updates, and unconditionally states “The Board has not published events for this cycle yet” for that empty list. Therefore an RPC failure takes the same publication-copy branch as a successful empty response.
findings.userImpact: A student can infer that no events have been announced when dates merely failed to load, potentially missing an active recruitment opportunity. The page also directs them toward an interest-list action without establishing cycle availability.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve a distinct unavailable result from the RPC. Show neutral load-failure copy with retry/contact guidance; reserve the unpublished-events claim for a successful response. Add a focused failure-versus-empty journey check.

notVerified: No staging, hosted integration or deployment exists. Clerk sessions, production RPC/RLS, uploads and actual email delivery remain unverified; intercepted contact success is not delivery proof.
No observed human comprehension, application completion or operator acceptance was supplied. Static source inspection and synthetic Chromium checks do not establish these outcomes.

Client-approved case-study outcomes and project artifacts remain absent. Publication proof covers a synthetic project and generated image routes; external crawler/social cache refresh and hosted withdrawal behavior were not demonstrated.
Original resumes may identify applicants, as the application disclosure states. Board resolution of the blind-review policy and retention process remains outstanding.
Physical devices, assistive technology, Safari and Firefox were not inspected. Captures establish only the supplied local render appearance.
